text: {"name":"mac_rx_packet_process","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Validates an incoming 802.11 RX buffer, attaches it to an available receive descriptor, updates station/TID accounting, and hands it off for per-interface processing.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v1":"station_idx","v2":"vif_idx","v4":"vif_context_base","v5":"rx_queue_id","v6":"rx_descriptor","v11":"station_idx","v12":"tid"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":22,"meaning":"Incoming RX metadata: receive queue or category index."},{"offset":23,"meaning":"Incoming RX metadata: TID or priority used in per-station accounting."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Incoming RX metadata: VIF index."},{"offset":25,"meaning":"Incoming RX metadata: station index."},{"offset":26,"meaning":"Incoming RX metadata flags; bit 3 selects an alternate processing path."},{"offset":30,"meaning":"RX descriptor status/flags halfword; low bits are cleared before handoff."},{"offset":72,"meaning":"RX descriptor pointer to the packet-pool allocation."},{"offset":76,"meaning":"RX descriptor pointer to a bookkeeping object whose fields at offsets +4 and +72 are cleared."}]}
